propositions: Convergence test oracles that re-derive the external effect from helper composition instead of capturing from the real call site remain green when the send path drifts, defeating their purpose

Two instances in test_outbound_comment_length_convergence.py and its fix used re-derived models (truncate_comment_body and fit_preserving_marker) that became stale while tests passed; the correct pattern is exemplified by test_comment_dedup_key_matches_send_fit.py which captures the --body argument from acli_cli_ops.add_comment
The rule that convergence/agreement tests must capture external-effect side from the real call site rather than recompute it must be added as authoring guidance to the shared test-design standard
Per-skill copies of test-design.md (rebar-debug, rebar-implement, rebar-brainstorm) must be synced byte-identically to the canonical shared copy and enforced by test_skill_shared_sync.py

A mechanical lint check to flag re-derived convergence tests is infeasible because legitimate characterization tests use the same import/AST pattern; the check would either produce unacceptable false positives or become unmaintainable
